PROP-lean-slashing-001.text: The decidable double-vote checker must flag exactly the validators that signed two distinct targets at one target epoch (S1)
PROP-lean-slashing-001.assertion: slashed_double_vote_iff_bex guarantees [slashedB st v = true ↔ ∃ a1 ∈ st.votes, ∃ a2 ∈ st.votes, double_vote v a1 a2] with no must-establish preconditions; audit context: slashedB_S1(st,v) <-> exists two attestations by v with same target_epoch and distinct target_root
